name: v1.25.5
body:
## Installation

See the [installation instructions](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/install/ddev-installation/) for details, but it's easy:

- macOS: `brew install ddev/ddev/ddev` or just `brew upgrade ddev`.
- Linux: Use `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install ddev`, see [apt/yum installation](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/install/ddev-installation/#linux)
- Windows and WSL2: Download the [Windows Installer](https://ddev.com/download/); you can run it for install or upgrade.
- Consider `ddev delete images` or `ddev delete images --all` after upgrading to free up disk space used by previous Docker image versions. This does no harm.
- Consider `ddev config --auto` to update your projects to current configuration.

## Highlights

Blog announcement: https://ddev.com/blog/release-v1-25-5/

- **Initial [PHP 8.6](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#php_version) support** (8.6.0 RC3, some extensions not available yet)
- **A rebuilt [`ddev tui`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#tui)** with a new layout, clickable links, and more project actions
- **Use your existing SSH agent** (e.g. macOS, 1Password, `ssh -A`) with [`ssh_agent_upstream`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/cli/#using-an-existing-ssh-agent)
- **[`ddev restart -s <service>`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#restart)** restarts only the services you name
- **QR codes** for [`ddev share`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#share) and [`ddev launch --qr`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#launch)
- **zstd** for [`ddev import-db`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#import-db), [`ddev import-files`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#import-files), and [`ddev export-db`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#export-db)
- **[Global hooks](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/hooks/#global-hooks)**, and [`global_config.*.yaml` files](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#environmental-overrides) that extend `global_config.yaml`

## PHP Security Fixes

See [PHP2Shell: What DDEV Users Need to Know](https://ddev.com/blog/php2shell-what-ddev-users-need-to-know/) for who is affected and how to update PHP without upgrading DDEV.

- `ddev-webserver` ships PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35, which fix CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, see the [PHP announcement](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5). deb.sury.org [also patched PHP 5.6 through 8.1](https://codeberg.org/oerdnj/deb.sury.org/issues/145#issuecomment-25974932), and upgrading DDEV rebuilds those projects' web images with the fixed packages
- PHP 8.6 is still 8.6.0 RC3, which has neither fix, because deb.sury.org hasn't packaged RC4 yet. DDEV applies the php.net mitigations for CVE-2026-109619 (`session.upload_progress.enabled = 0` and `fatal_error_backtraces = 0`), but CVE-2026-109618 stays open, so don't expose a PHP 8.6 project
- PHP 8.4.27 and 8.5.12 have an upstream SimpleXML regression that can crash with `zend_mm_heap corrupted`, see [php-src#24488](https://github.com/php/php-src/issues/24488)

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- `session.upload_progress.enabled` is `0` in every PHP version, as [php.net recommends](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-23-1), and `fatal_error_backtraces` is `0` in PHP 8.6. Few applications use session upload progress, and the PECL `uploadprogress` extension that Drupal uses isn't affected. To turn either back on, add it under `[PHP]` in `.ddev/php/overrides.ini`, see [Custom PHP Configuration](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customization-extendibility/#custom-php-configuration-phpini), and run `ddev restart`
- The default nginx configurations for Drupal, Backdrop, Magento 1/2, Maho, and Silverstripe changed slightly, and now deny PHP in upload directories. If you removed `#ddev-generated` from `.ddev/nginx_full/nginx-site.conf`, merge the changes from the new template into your copy
- WP-CLI, Drush 8, the Backdrop Drush extension, magerun, magerun2, and Symfony CLI are installed only in the project types that use them. To use one in another project type, add it in a `web-build` Dockerfile, see [Project-Specific Utilities](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customizing-images/#project-specific-utilities)
- `ddev export-db --file=x.sql` writes plain SQL. Before, it wrote gzip data to a file named `.sql`
- A custom service or add-on whose `container_name` isn't `ddev-<project>-<service>` is renamed, with a warning. Anything that reached it by its old name should use the service name
- DDEV assigns host ports itself instead of leaving it to Docker or Podman. Unconfigured db, web, and Mailpit host ports move to 20000-29999 the next time their containers are created, and the router's fallback ports ("Port 443 is not available, using ... instead") move to 30000-32000. Configured `host_*_port` values don't change
- `--profiles` replaces `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, as in Compose, so on a stopped project `ddev start --profiles=x` no longer starts the profiles in `COMPOSE_PROFILES` as well, see [Optional Services](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/custom-compose-files/#optional-services)
- `ddev delete` exits with an error and keeps the project listed when it can't remove a volume. Before, it reported success
- Any `global_config.*.yaml` file in `~/.ddev`, such as a leftover `global_config.old.yaml`, is now merged into the global configuration. Rename or remove files you don't want applied
- In `ddev tui`, `R` restarts and `r` refreshes, swapped from before, and only `enter` opens the project view
- `DDEV_DEBUG` no longer shows image download progress per layer or routine start messages. Use [`DDEV_VERBOSE`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/troubleshooting/#debug-environment-variables) to see them

## Features

- [PHP 8.6](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#php_version) can be selected. deb.sury.org doesn't package every extension for it yet, and enabling Xdebug, XHProf, or Blackfire on 8.6 gives a clear error
- [`ddev tui`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#tui) has a new layout that fits any window size, shows the project list before Docker responds, and adds database addresses, snapshots, published ports, and available add-on updates to the project view
- `ddev tui` shows paths and URLs as clickable links, and `o`, `v`, and `p` open a project in the file manager, VS Code, or PhpStorm. URLs printed by other commands are clickable too
- `D` in `ddev tui` deletes a project, thanks to @MitraKumar
- Up and down wrap around the `ddev tui` project list, so the last project is one key away from the first
- [`ssh_agent_upstream`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#ssh_agent_upstream) lets containers use an SSH agent running on the host or forwarded to it, so keys that exist only in an agent work without `ddev auth ssh` key files. See [Using an Existing SSH Agent](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/cli/#using-an-existing-ssh-agent). It also follows a symlinked agent socket, such as VS Code Remote's `/tmp/vscode-ssh-auth-sock-*`, and `ddev auth ssh` reports an agent socket that's gone after a reconnect in a single message
- [`ddev restart -s solr,redis`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#restart) recreates only those services and leaves the rest running. `ddev restart --profiles=x` replaces `ddev restart && ddev start --profiles=x`, and [`ddev utility rebuild -s`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#utility-rebuild) accepts several services
- Ctrl-C, SIGTERM, or closing the terminal no longer leaves temporary containers like `start-chown-*` holding project volumes. Interrupting `ddev import-db`, `ddev export-db`, or `ddev snapshot` leaves no partial dump, snapshot, or temporary directory, and Ctrl-C stops a shell loop that runs `ddev`
- [`ddev share`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#share) prints a QR code for the tunnel URL, and [`ddev launch --qr`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#launch) prints the project URL with its QR code. This replaces the ddev-qr add-on, which `ddev start` now removes. thanks to @tyler36, who started this in [ddev-qr](https://github.com/ddev/ddev-qr)
- [`ddev import-db`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#import-db) and [`ddev import-files`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#import-files) accept zstd files. [`ddev export-db --compression`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#export-db) chooses gzip, bzip2, xz, zstd, or none, and without the flag the format comes from the file extension, as in `ddev export-db -f db.sql.zst`
- [Global hooks](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/hooks/#global-hooks) in `global_config.yaml` run for every project, before the project's own hooks. [`global_config.*.yaml` files](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#environmental-overrides) in `~/.ddev` are merged over `global_config.yaml`, as `config.*.yaml` files are in a project
- `ddev config global` with flags prints only the settings you changed, instead of the whole global configuration
- New [`pre-delete` and `post-delete` hooks](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/hooks/#supported-command-hooks) can remove files a project created, without doing it on every `ddev stop`, thanks to @wazum
- [`ddev start`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#start) in a directory that looks like a web project but has no `.ddev` configuration shows what `ddev config --auto` would create, and lets you accept it, change it, or cancel
- `ddev list`, `ddev describe`, and `ddev tui` respond faster, and the difference grows with the number of running projects
- `ddev start` shows each step's time on that step's line, and pushing configuration to a router that's already running is about 1.4s faster
- `ddev start` warns when the router is running but its ports don't respond on the host, which happens with Lima or Colima on Linux for ports below 1024. See [Router Ports Not Reachable](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/troubleshooting/#router-ports-not-reachable)
- Web image builds can use your GitHub token through the `github_token` build secret. The docs explain how to install PHP extensions with [PIE](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customizing-images/#pie-php-extensions-not-supported-by-debsuryorg), or with PECL on older PHP versions
- `ddev utility download-ddev`, `ddev utility diagnose`, `ddev describe`, `ddev list`, `ddev dotenv`, and shell completion work when Docker is unavailable
- [Shopware 6](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/quickstart/#shopware) projects have the `ddev console` command, thanks to @ntzrbtr
- `ddev exec`, `ddev ssh`, and custom commands receive the [variables AI coding agents set](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/environment-variables/#host-variables-forwarded-on-exec) to identify themselves, thanks to @AkibaAT
- `ddev ssh` and `ddev exec` pass [`TERM_PROGRAM` and similar terminal variables](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/environment-variables/#host-variables-forwarded-on-exec), so tools in the container can print clickable links, thanks to @wazum
- [`x-ddev.container-user`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/in-container-configuration/#changing-the-container-user) sets the default user for `ddev ssh -s`, `ddev exec -s`, and custom commands in that service
- DDEV [sets `container_name` and `hostname`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/custom-compose-files/#conventions-for-defining-additional-services) for every compose service, so custom services and add-ons no longer need to
- Add-ons can tag a build service's image as `-${DDEV_SITENAME}-<service>-built` or list images to pull in [`x-ddev.pull-images`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/custom-docker-services/#service-with-a-custom-build). `ddev start` warns when two services build different images with the same tag
- With [`CI=true`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/troubleshooting/#debug-environment-variables), `ddev start` prints the logs of a container that exits or remains unhealthy, as it already did with `DDEV_DEBUG=true`

## Bug Fixes for Regressions

- Directory listing works again. v1.25.4's 403 explanation page had disabled it for every project
- `ddev composer create-project` again passes flags like `--no-dev` and `-vvv` to the Composer scripts it runs after creating the project, which v1.25.3 stopped doing
- Magento, Magento 2, and Maho show their own 404 pages again, instead of DDEV's explanation page, thanks to @gunnie-agency

## Bug Fixes

- nginx passes `PATH_INFO` to PHP, so URLs like `/index.php/foo/bar` work as they do with Apache
- `ddev start` no longer fails because of a stopped container from an earlier session that it wasn't asked to start
- Running `ddev start` or `ddev poweroff` in several terminals at once no longer breaks the shared router or Docker network, or loses hosts file entries. A command that has to wait [shows which process it is waiting for](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/troubleshooting/#waiting-for-another-ddev-process)
- Fixed a startup race that could stop the web container, and another that could delete files DDEV had just copied into a Docker volume
- DDEV recovers from an empty or corrupt `~/.ddev/.state.yaml` or `project_list.yaml` instead of failing on every command
- `ddev delete` removes leftover utility containers that kept the database volume in use, thanks to @wazum
- When the project directory is itself a symlink, Mutagen syncs it instead of leaving the docroot in the container empty, thanks to @dave-agilepixel
- `ddev export-db` always uses `--single-transaction`, and on MySQL 9.5+ it no longer writes GTID statements or fails on tablespace privileges. Snapshots call `mariadb-backup` instead of the deprecated `mariabackup`
- `composer` in the web container runs the system Composer from every shell, so PHP's `exec()`, Symfony Process, and `sh -c` no longer pick up `vendor/bin/composer`
- [`ddev add-on get`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#add-on-get) and [`ddev add-on update`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#add-on-update) install the release GitHub marks as latest, not whichever release GitHub lists first
- When you're [offline](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/offline/) and a project image can't be rebuilt, `ddev start` uses the images from the last successful build instead of failing
- `ddev start --profiles=x` builds that profile's images, and `--no-cache` also rebuilds profile images built earlier
- `ddev start` no longer panics when a compose service uses `network_mode`, such as `network_mode: service:web`
- MODX friendly URLs show the right page instead of the start page, thanks to @casparml
- [`ddev utility download-images`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#utility-download-images) honors each service's `platform:`, so amd64-only images download on Apple Silicon
- `ddev start` is faster with rootless Podman
- A pinned `webimage` or `dbimage` built from the current release image is no longer reported as outdated, thanks to @weitzman
- [`ddev utility download-ddev`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#utility-download-ddev) `--head` finds the latest `main` build reliably, and `--commit` accepts a short SHA

## Security Changes

- With `nginx-fpm`, PHP files in CMS upload directories no longer run. Drupal, Backdrop, Magento 1/2, Maho, and Silverstripe block them only with an `.htaccess` file, which nginx ignores, so the nginx templates now deny them, as the WordPress template already did for `uploads`
- `/phpstatus` returns 403 to requests from outside the web container, so they no longer reach PHP-FPM through it, which matters for bugs like PHP2Shell. If you removed `#ddev-generated` from `.ddev/apache/apache-site.conf`, add `Require ip 127.0.0.1` to its `<Location "/phpstatus">`

## Internal Changes

- The database server uses a 256M redo log where the version supports resizing it, a 512M buffer pool, a connection collation that matches the server's, and a separate slow query log. The redo log is resized on the first start after upgrading, which adds about 160-210M to each project's database volume
- The web container logs to `/proc/1/fd/1` instead of the `/var/tmp/logpipe` FIFO. [Supervisor configs](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customization-extendibility/#explicit-supervisord-configuration-for-additional-daemons) that log to `/var/tmp/logpipe` keep working through a symlink
- With Mutagen, the project volume is mounted only at `/var/www`, and ownership changes skip the bind mounts below it
- Docs: 6GB of memory for the Podman machine on macOS, the SvelteKit quickstart updated for SvelteKit 3, [keeping changes made inside the web container across restarts](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/in-container-configuration/#persisting-changes-across-restarts), separate pages for [custom compose files](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/custom-compose-files/) and [custom services](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/custom-docker-services/), and [replacing the router's page for unknown hostnames with a maintenance page](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/traefik-router/#custom-maintenance-page)
- docs.ddev.com pages have social preview cards and a "Copy as Markdown" button, and the site publishes [`llms.txt`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/llms.txt) and [`llms-full.txt`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/llms-full.txt) for AI tools

## Minor Updates

- PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35
- Node.js 24.22.1, npm 11.19.1
- Docker Compose v5.6.1, recommended buildx 0.38.1
